name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: Russia launched 141 drones overnight into 18 Nov, 126 downed; a jet drone reached Kyiv after the 17 Nov bridge strikes
state: Ukraine's air force said Russia launched 141 drones overnight into 18 Nov and 126 were downed (Ukrinform). A jet-powered drone reached Kyiv on the morning of 18 Nov, with debris falling in Darnytskyi district (Censor.NET). This follows the 17 Nov strike by seven ballistic missiles on Kyiv's two main Dnipro bridges, which disrupted water and heating (Kyiv Independent). Sustained mass strikes on infrastructure keep the Alert.
for_you: Check FCDO travel advice: it advises against all travel to Ukraine and parts of Russia.
rubric_hit: Mass strikes on infrastructure = significant escalation (Alert)
